create_pruning_random_unstructured: create a random unstructured pruning method that removes a fraction of parameters at random
create_pruning_l1_unstructured: create an L1-based unstructured pruning method that removes parameters with lowest magnitude
create_pruning_structured: create a structured pruning method that removes entire channels along a specified dimension
apply_global_unstructured_pruning: apply global unstructured pruning across multiple parameters using importance scores
remove_pruning_reparameterization: remove pruning reparameterization from a module while keeping the pruned weights
